# Architecture

<!-- awf:edit overview: stub; replace by creating .awf/docs/parts/architecture/overview.md -->
## Overview

awf renders a repository's selected workflow from committed `.awf/` configuration. The Go CLI validates, renders, and checks that configuration; generated target artifacts provide the agent-facing workflow. Its resident-data boundaries keep local effort and worktree state outside managed output.

<!-- awf:edit components: stub; replace by creating .awf/docs/parts/architecture/components.md -->
## Components

- `cmd/awf`: CLI composition root; auxiliary commands may provide repository checks and diagnostics.
- `internal/project`: configuration loading, rendering, output planning, and repository checks.
- `internal/adr`, `internal/currentstate`, and `internal/plan`: durable decision, live-authority, and plan parsing.
- `internal/effort` and `internal/worktree`: local effort residents and Git-backed topology.
- `internal/git`: the sole semantic Git boundary.
- Generated Pi extensions: an awf-owned protocol-v2 profile adapter and retained effort integration; independently installed, unpinned `pi-tools` owns general Pi mechanics, and successful handshake plus final registration define no-fallback compatibility.

<!-- awf:edit data-flow: stub; replace by creating .awf/docs/parts/architecture/data-flow.md -->
## Data flow

A command loads `.awf/`, derives an output plan, and renders or checks the managed files. `.awf/awf.lock` records the render transaction. Current-state checks read working or staged authority; audit reads selected committed history through `internal/git`. Effort residents and worktrees remain local state outside rendered output.

<!-- awf:edit dependencies: stub; replace by creating .awf/docs/parts/architecture/dependencies.md -->
## Key dependencies

| Dependency | Role |
|---|---|
| `gopkg.in/yaml.v3` | Strict configuration and frontmatter parsing. |
| `text/template` | Rendering. |
| `github.com/go-git/go-git/v5` and Git | Git seam backends. |
| `github.com/bmatcuk/doublestar/v4` | Anchored path glob matching. |
| Pi APIs | Adopter-supplied runtime APIs for awf-owned outputs, not CLI dependencies. |
| `pi-tools` | Independently installed general context, handoff, and subagent mechanics; protocol-v2 compatible, not revision-pinned. |
